The '''Vendusii system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Vendusii sector/Legends|Vendusii sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] known as [[Vendusii Crystal]].<ref name="Heroes & Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Vendusii Crystal]]|system=Vendusii [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vendusii system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-16.<ref name="TEA" />
